t: You are looking at St Augustine's, Kilburn, a Church of England church in North London. Because of its size and ornate architecture, people affectionately call it the Cathedral of North London, though it is not a cathedral in any official sense. It was designed by John Loughborough Pearson, a Gothic Revival architect renowned for his churches and cathedrals. Pearson revived the art of vaulting and became unrivalled at it in his generation. In a career of 54 years he worked on at least 210 ecclesiastical buildings in England.
